item: 8.15 Bookmarks: a bookmark control on every finished assistant text block (live and replayed), the card above the composer (rows, detail, Show in conversation, remove, minimize), the store's list as truth, a withdrawn record dropping its bookmark, __clear resetting the card
branch: js/68-bookmarks.js (the card, bmToggle/bmSet/bmDrop/bmJump); copyable() in js/20-markdown.js adds .blk-mark; replay stamps data-uuid (js/55-replay.js); stampMessage/evictUuids in js/75-retraction.js call bmMarkOne/bmDrop; padLog() in js/60-composer.js adds the card's height; js/70-events.js: the whole-message path resets the uuid tracker before drawing (its own frame is the stamp)
provenance: Wire shapes: `assistant` frames carry `uuid` (measured on real transcripts 2026-10-27: unique per record, one text block per record); `__transcript` items are SessionStore.Item.toJson (uuid added 2026-10-27); `__bookmarks` is ChatPanel.pushBookmarks' own frame; the refusal-fallback frame is fixture 56's shape. The bridge is stubbed: nothing here reaches Kotlin.
